title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
author: Qinfeng Zhu, Weiguang Zhao, Ke Sun, Xihao Guo et al.

summary: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence. These advances make agentic robotics a promising path toward artificial general intelligence in robotics.
takeaways: LEASH leverages a decision model (Jev or OpenAI's Decisions API) to implement task, action, and commit gates, which review the task, each action, and each irreversible operation in their visual context.
We introduce RoboRisk, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating safety in agentic robotics.
We evaluate six state-of-the-art foundation models on RoboRisk: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, and Grok 4.7.
